title: Crypto Portfolio Value Trend
dataSources: Crypto prices/holdings (`crypto:price`, `wallet:balance`), exchange transactions (`coinbase:txn`), budget/transaction exports (`firefly:txn`, `ynab:txn`), bill feeds.
app: Crypto exchange/wallet APIs (Coinbase, on-chain), budgeting exports (YNAB/Firefly III), and subscription trackers via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=crypto:price
| stats latest(price_usd) as price by symbol
| lookup holdings symbol OUTPUT amount
| eval value=round(price*amount,2)
| stats sum(value) as portfolio_value
| eval portfolio_value="$".tostring(portfolio_value,"commas")
description: Combines live prices with your holdings to show your total crypto portfolio value in one number, without handing your keys to a third-party app.
value: A self-hosted portfolio view keeps your holdings private and puts the number you care about front and centre, updated as often as you like.
implementation: Ingest prices to `index=personal` and keep holdings in a lookup; schedule frequently and trend total value over time.
visualization: Single-value portfolio total with a value-over-time trend.
grandmaExplanation: It adds up what your crypto is worth right now, all in one place and without sharing your details with an app.
